deskyard env list: list the environments you can see

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] env list [--json]

Lists the environments your account can see on the server, with their state,
your access level, image and who is viewing. Administrators see every
environment, and the containers the server can't match (conflicts) on stderr.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -e SERVER/ENV names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a table NAME STATE ACCESS IMAGE VIEWERS; with --json the API's answer
  {environments:[Environment],conflicts:[Conflict]} (see the server's
  API reference)

Examples:
  deskyard env list
  deskyard env list --json

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
